learning.title: After a click that navigates, read browser storage from the context, not with page.evaluate
learning.trigger: A Playwright spec clicks a control that submits to another origin (the GitHub App manifest form) and then asserts on localStorage or another page-side value, and CI fails with "page.evaluate: Execution context was destroyed, most likely because of a navigation".
learning.mistake: expect.poll on the intercepted request resolves while the page is still replacing its document, so page.evaluate raced the navigation (1 failure in 430 cases on a loaded runner, none in 30 local repeats). When it won the race it read the destination origin's storage, so the check was blind to a leak into Bakery's own storage: with the value seeded into Bakery's localStorage the old assertion still passed.
learning.rule: Assert storage with page.context().storageState(), which reads every origin the page visited without needing a live execution context. A race that does not reproduce locally is argued from the CI stack trace, so prove the new assertion is not vacuous instead: seed the value into Bakery's storage before the click and see the case fail.

verification.requirement: With the value seeded into Bakery's localStorage the AC2 case fails; without it 30 repeats pass.
